turns.question: How many customers placed more than three orders between 17 August and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric that counts customers by how many orders they placed in a period, so I cannot give this figure. The closest metrics are Active customers (customers_distinct: distinct customers with at least one non-cancelled order in the period) and Repeat customers (repeat_customers: customers with two or more orders in all, not a count above three within 17 August to 2 October 2026); no query was run, so there is no freshness statement.
